label: S. 5088
title: Ensuring Kids Have Access to Medically Necessary Dental Care Act

items.snippet: This bill modifies dental coverage under the Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP).
It also requires states to offer dental-only supplemental coverage under CHIP to children who have other health insurance but are otherwise eligible for CHIP (i.e., wraparound coverage);

A000382.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
A000382.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
A000382.note: None of the lobbying clients on this bill matched an industry rule, so there is nothing to compare.
